conventions.frame_ids: frame id = id of the canonical annihilator; record "a" lists integer annihilator rows (frame = common kernel), record "b" lists integer basis rows; id 0 (empty "a") is the full space Q^h
conventions.gram: G = I - J/9 on Q^h (H0 = G/2, H0(chi_S,chi_T) = (|S cap T|-1)/2); nondegeneracy tested for G
conventions.nodes: zero-based graph nodes; nodes < v are the source leaves (port index)
conventions.ops: [dest, control, node]: dest ^= control at the frame of node (copies: dest is the fresh role)
conventions.target_covector: 3*chi_T - 1 (target cap = {u : (3 chi_T - 1).u = 0} = H0-orthogonal complement of chi_T)
